description: This file defines the ExistsFieldExpression interface, which is part of a query expression framework for field existence checks in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for visiting the expression using visitor patterns.

classes.name: ExistsFieldExpression
classes.description: Interface representing an existence check for a field in query expressions, with methods for visitor pattern acceptance.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor specifically for ExistsFieldExpression, enabling custom processing logic.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a generic FieldExpressionVisitor for processing the expression.
